from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import http.client
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import zipfile

BASE_SHA='92d3e858cb93471b1fe4e633e2b5328aa43dc178f325a9bfa65ca62d1405b7e3'

def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:return hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()

def safe(root,name):
    if not isinstance(name,str) or not name or any(c in name for c in '\\:') or PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute() or any(p in {'','.','..'} for p in name.split('/')):raise ValueError('unsafe input path')
    p=root
    for part in name.split('/'):
        p=p/part
        if p.is_symlink():raise ValueError('input symlink rejected')
    return p

def load(name,file):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,file);module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[name]=module;spec.loader.exec_module(module);return module

def probe(profile,update):
    sys.path.insert(0,str(profile/'src'));sys.path.insert(0,str(update))
    app=load('exactbase_app',profile/'app/server.py')
    setup=load('setup_live2d_owner',update/'setup_live2d_owner.py');lock=setup.read_lock()
    assert setup.selected_packages(lock,'win32-x64')
    failure=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stderr(failure):
        try:setup.main(['install','--application-root',str(profile.parents[1])])
        except SystemExit as error:assert error.code==2
        else:raise AssertionError('owner setup must refuse absent acknowledgements')
    assert 'acknowledgement' in failure.getvalue()
    server=app.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),app.Handler);worker=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);worker.start()
    results={}
    try:
        for path,wanted in [('/stage-actions.js',200),('/stage-actions.js.not-allowed',404)]:
            connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',server.server_port,timeout=8)
            connection.request('GET',path);response=connection.getresponse();body=response.read();connection.close()
            assert response.status==wanted,(path,response.status)
            if wanted==200:assert body==(profile/'app/static/stage-actions.js').read_bytes()
            results[path]={'status':response.status,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(body)}
    finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();worker.join(timeout=5)
    print(json.dumps({'profile':str(profile),'version':app.VERSION,'actual_backend_routes':results,'owner_helper_loaded':True,'owner_lock_verified':True,'owner_setup_without_ack_refused':True,'network_download_performed':False}))

def main(args):
    started=time.monotonic();assert not args.work_root.exists(),'Use a fresh, disposable work path'
    assert not args.report.exists(),'Do not overwrite evidence'
    assert sha(args.base_archive)==BASE_SHA,'Wrong original base archive'
    assert sha(args.update_zip)==args.expected_update_sha,'Wrong update artifact'
    args.work_root.mkdir(parents=True);update=args.work_root/'update';target=args.work_root/'target';update.mkdir();target.mkdir()
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(args.update_zip) as archive:
            infos=archive.infolist();assert len(infos)<=512
            assert sum(i.file_size for i in infos)<=96*1024*1024
            names=set()
            for info in infos:
                output=safe(update,info.filename);mode=stat.S_IFMT(info.external_attr>>16)
                assert not info.is_dir() and mode in {0,stat.S_IFREG} and not info.flag_bits&1
                assert info.filename.casefold() not in names;names.add(info.filename.casefold())
                output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                with archive.open(info) as source,output.open('xb') as dest:shutil.copyfileobj(source,dest,1024*1024)
        sys.path.insert(0,str(update));updater=load('app_update',update/'app_update.py')
        manifest=updater.load_update(update)
        assert manifest['base_archive_sha256']==BASE_SHA
        assert manifest['new_source_commit']==args.expected_source_commit
        copy_paths={op['target'] for op in manifest['files'] if op['old_sha256'] is not None}
        needed=set(copy_paths)|{'companion-desktop.exe','resources/backend/python/python.exe'}
        for prefix in updater.PROFILES.values():

            needed.update(prefix+'/'+name for name in profile['source_files'])
            copy_paths.update(prefix+'/'+name for name in profile['source_files'])
            needed.update(prefix+'/'+name for name in profile['critical_files'])
        original={};copied=linked=copy_bytes=0
        for name in sorted(needed):
            source=safe(args.base_root,name);destination=safe(target,name)
            assert source.is_file();original[name]=sha(source);destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            if name in copy_paths or source.suffix in {'.py','.json','.txt','.cjs','.js','.css','.html'}:
                shutil.copy2(source,destination);copied+=1;copy_bytes+=source.stat().st_size
            else:os.link(source,destination);linked+=1
        sentinels={target/'owner-data/private-role-sentinel.sqlite':b'SYNTHETIC PRIVATE DATA DO NOT CHANGE',target/'models/unchanged-model-sentinel.gguf':b'SYNTHETIC MODEL SENTINEL NO INFERENCE'}
        for path,data in sentinels.items():path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_bytes(data)

        updater.verify_state(target,manifest,'old')

        applied=updater.execute(target,update);assert applied['status']=='applied';checks['actual_execute_apply']=True
        updater.verify_state(target,manifest,'new');checks['both_profiles_new_hashes_source_ids']=True
        assert updater.execute(target,update)['status']=='already_applied';checks['repeat_is_idempotent']=True
        package=json.loads((target/'resources/app/package.json').read_bytes());assert package['version']=='0.5.0-dev3' and package['name']=='companion-desktop-runtime' and package['main']=='main.cjs'
        probes=[]
        for name,prefix in updater.PROFILES.items():
            environment={**os.environ,'COMPANION_DATA':str(args.work_root/('http-data-'+name)),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','HF_HUB_OFFLINE':'1','TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE':'1'}
            result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(Path(__file__).resolve()),'--probe-profile',str(target/prefix),'--update-root',str(update)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=environment,timeout=45)
            assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr;probes.append(json.loads(result.stdout))
        checks['actual_copied_cpu_cuda_backend_routes_and_owner_setup_load']=True
        assert updater.execute(target,update,rollback=True)['status']=='rolled_back';updater.verify_state(target,manifest,'old');checks['actual_execute_rollback']=True
        assert {name:updater.file_hash(safe(target,name)) for name in expected_old}==expected_old;checks['every_operation_original_sha_restored']=True
        assert {name:sha(safe(args.base_root,name)) for name in original}==original;checks['all_selected_original_base_inputs_unchanged']=True
        assert all(path.read_bytes()==data for path,data in sentinels.items());checks['synthetic_model_and_owner_data_unchanged']=True
        assert sha(args.base_archive)==BASE_SHA;checks['original_base_archive_still_exact']=True
        report={'passed':True,'scope':'Exact published Windows-base bytes, minimal disposable copies, actual final-artifact execute/apply/repeat/rollback and loopback copied-backend routes on Linux. No Windows cmd/exe/DLL, GPU, model inference or media capture execution.','checks':checks,'base_archive_sha256':BASE_SHA,'update_archive_sha256':args.expected_update_sha,'source_commit':args.expected_source_commit,'source_id':manifest['new_source_id'],'operations':len(manifest['files']),'copied_files':copied,'copied_bytes':copy_bytes,'readonly_native_hardlinks':linked,'profile_probes':probes,'script_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'windows_execution_verified':False,'downloads_performed':False,'original_base_modified':False,'disposable_target_removed_after_test':True}
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
    except BaseException as error:
        failure=args.report.with_suffix('.failure.json');failure.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);failure.write_text(json.dumps({'passed':False,'error':str(error),'windows_execution_verified':False,'script_sha256':sha(Path(__file__))},indent=2)+'\n');raise
    finally:
        # Only this invocation's fresh disposable target/update; never base/user data.
        shutil.rmtree(args.work_root)

    if '--probe-profile' in sys.argv:

    else:
        p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--base-archive',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--base-root',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--update-zip',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--expected-update-sha',required=True);p.add_argument('--expected-source-commit',required=True);p.add_argument('--work-root',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--report',type=Path,required=True);main(p.parse_args())
